customManagers.description: Keep docsight/build.yaml's pinned upstream tag in sync with the Dockerfile's ARG BUILD_FROM

prBodyNotes: **This only bumps the pinned upstream tag in `Dockerfile`/`build.yaml`.** It does NOT update `docsight/config.yaml`'s `version` field, and merging this PR does not publish a new image (that only happens on a GitHub Release). After merging, still manually: 1) bump `version` in `docsight/config.yaml` to `<new-upstream-tag>-addon.1`, 2) add a `docsight/CHANGELOG.md` entry, 3) create a matching GitHub Release to trigger the publish workflow.
